title: Spectrum
definition: Electromagnetic spectrum refers to the entire range of frequencies or wavelengths of electromagnetic radiation, partitioned into bands for communication, broadcasting, and scientific applications.
importanceInUpsc: Critical microtopic under GS Paper-III (Science & Technology - IT, Communication, AI, Robotics). Regularly tested via spectrum auctions, 5G/6G rollout, TRAI regulations, and national security implications.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and propagation physics of the electromagnetic spectrum.
Evaluate spatial distribution, spectrum management institutions, and telecom policy frameworks.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions on frequency bands.
prerequisites: Basic physics of electromagnetic waves (frequency, wavelength, speed of light)
